sources.facts: Linux uses ordinary sockaddr_un; SetupSockAddr rejects path length at least sun_path size. Create builds a unique temporary socket directory, checks mode0700, appends SingletonSocket, then sets up its address. The fatal fixed text is Socket path too long:.
sources.scope: Current reviewed source, not the unrecorded hosted browser binary version.

sources.facts: GetTempDir uses nonempty TMPDIR on Linux. New temporary directories use the brand prefix plus six random characters. Current code passes hidden=false, omitting the leading dot; older reviewed versions used a leading dot.
sources.scope: Current reviewed source; both naming variants evaluated.

sources.facts: Linux sockaddr_un.sun_path is108bytes. Chromium reserves NUL, so its pathname acceptance is at most107bytes.
Reviewed older ScopedTempDir implementation routes CreateUniqueTempDir through CreateNewTempDirectory; current singleton call explicitly supplies an empty prefix.
sources.scope: Historical corroboration; current scoped_temp_dir.cc full page was unavailable through the web lookup.
